evals.prompt: Users say the weekly report puts Sunday sales in the wrong week. Diagnose and fix it.
expectations: Before forming theories from reading code, the agent builds a red-capable feedback loop (a failing test or script asserting a Sunday's ISO week, e.g. 2026-10-18 is 2026-W42) and runs it, showing it red
The agent states several ranked hypotheses before testing them
The fix is verified by the same loop going green, and the full suite passes
A regression test for the Sunday case is left in the suite

evals.prompt: parseLog got about 10x slower in release 2.3.0. Diagnose it.
expectations: The agent builds a timing loop on a large generated input and records a baseline measurement before changing code
The agent states ranked hypotheses for the slowdown before testing them
The slowdown is fixed (the per-line array copy is removed) and the speed-up is shown with the same timing loop
The existing behaviour test still passes after the change
